function.text: TRPS1 encodes zinc finger transcription factor Trps1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to trichorhinophalangeal syndrome type I (autosomal dominant); trichorhinophalangeal syndrome, type III (autosomal dominant).
